claim_boundary: All entries are candidate fixes until exact-head Linux, hosted Windows, installer and native installed-runtime evidence pass.

defects.title: Safe archives were excluded unless they contained one XLSX
defects.baseline: ZIP archives with CSV, JSON, XML, multiple spreadsheets or mixed safe members were registered but excluded from finance.
defects.fix: Resource-bounded recursive extraction for ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ/TGZ, GZIP, BZIP2 and XZ; per-member results preserve safe siblings.

defects.title: Unknown products or unattributed rows globally blocked the period
defects.baseline: Any unresolved attribution returned CALCULATION_BLOCKED with no group calculations.
defects.fix: Known scopes calculate independently; unresolved scopes remain visible with reason codes and are excluded from complete totals.

defects.title: Financial profile could not be saved partially
defects.baseline: Saving tax while cost was unknown, or cost while tax was unknown, was rejected.
defects.fix: Provided values are validated and normalized; missing values persist as missing and block only dependent metrics.

defects.title: Safe XLSX was routed through a specific schema-review prerequisite
defects.baseline: A workbook could require a particular sheet/header review before processing.
defects.fix: Every safe XLSX/XLSM is processed as a universal table source; discovered sheet/header information is shown without requiring one report schema.

defects.title: Universal GUI calculation path referenced an unavailable symbol
defects.baseline: The UI could raise NameError when invoking calculate_metric_groups.
defects.fix: The shared runtime explicitly exports the universal partial calculation function and the GUI path is regression-tested.

defects.title: Partial pre-tax and tax coverage could produce a misleading net-profit total
defects.baseline: Totals could combine amounts computed over different product/source coverage.
defects.fix: Net profit and per-unit profit require equal dependency coverage; otherwise the metric is BLOCKED with a coverage-mismatch reason.

defects.title: Overlapping source values could be selected or combined without explicit conflict
defects.baseline: Multiple files providing the same metric did not always expose incompatible coverage or values.
defects.fix: Complementary metrics merge; overlapping independent evidence becomes CONFLICT and is never silently selected or summed.

defects.title: Partial results were represented as a global block
defects.baseline: Calculated figures, missing figures and needed inputs were not consistently separated in all outputs.
defects.fix: Metric states VALID/PARTIAL/BLOCKED, coverage and unresolved scopes are consistent in GUI, JSON, XLSX and HTML.

defects.title: Result persistence depended on a non-canonical imported atomic writer
defects.baseline: save_run_result could fail depending on wildcard export composition.
defects.fix: Finance engine owns a bounded canonical atomic JSON writer.

defects.title: Filename suffix could override actual safe text content
defects.baseline: A CSV renamed .json or .bin could be rejected or misclassified.
defects.fix: Content classification precedes extension hints, while malformed genuine JSON/XML remains explicitly invalid.

defects.title: Unsupported RAR and 7z could be confused with generic binary failures
defects.baseline: Operator feedback did not clearly identify optional-adapter archive formats.
defects.fix: RAR and 7z are registered as unsupported archives with an explicit optional-adapter reason; content is not guessed.

defects.title: Unconfigured self-test used a stale known-answer count representation
defects.baseline: A valid integer count of 2 was compared with 2.00 and could produce a false technical failure.
defects.fix: Known-answer self-test uses the canonical integer representation and preserves CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED as distinct from FAILED.

defects.title: Native one-click rejected the valid universal partial intake state
defects.baseline: The installed workflow completed safely with ACCEPTED_PARTIAL, but the historical Red Team script required only ADMISSION_COMPLETE.
defects.fix: Native installed-runtime validation accepts both the legacy admission state and the current universal partial state while still requiring calculation to remain absent in ADMISSION_ONLY mode.

defects.title: Windows and clean-room CI omitted the declared build backend
defects.baseline: Complete source CI could fail with Cannot import setuptools.build_meta although runtime and focused contracts passed.
defects.fix: M7, M8, M5 and native exact-head CI install pinned setuptools 80.9.0 plus hash-locked runtime dependencies without cache reuse where required.

defects.title: M5 runtime workflow could validate only its historical construction commit
defects.baseline: A later protocol-authorized exact head failed before M5 tests solely because its parent was not the original M5 RTM.
defects.fix: M5 accepts the immutable original construction or the explicit UPR1 superseding RTM/base pair, while still rejecting arbitrary ancestry.

defects.title: Clean-room reproduction depended on runner-preinstalled packaging tools
defects.baseline: Fresh Linux and Windows environments could differ depending on whether setuptools happened to be preinstalled.
defects.fix: M8 installs the exact build backend explicitly before repository CI and native one-click reproduction.

not_claimed: OCR of images or scanned PDF
native RAR or 7z extraction without an installed adapter
semantic interpretation of arbitrary unknown columns
